text:
alex: Quick PSA — final slim+format sweep for this release. Cutoff in ~6h. Please add a concise one-liner to keep-a-changelog on your PRs (see tiny template below). If you will claim ownership of the changelog entry, reply here with "claimed" so I can keep a queue. :eyes:

release-bot: Reminder: release window opens 6h, cutoff at 2272504834. Auto-check will run 30m before cutoff and flag missing entries.

maria: claimed — i'll add for the model-autoscaler PR (it needs a one-liner and a component tag).

jack: quick q: what counts as a valid one-liner? small bugfixs? or only user-facing features?

alex: anything user- or infra-facing that we'd mention in release notes. Keep it short, 1 line, start with component in brackets. Examples: 
```
[autoscaler] reduce OOMs when batching by improving buffer reuse
[api] return 429 earlier for overloaded routes (configurable)
```
Prefer present-tense verbs, no PR prose. If it's internal-only and tiny, tag [internal].

sara: added my one-liner for #4123 — used [devtools] tag and short summary. ping me if you want wording tweaks.

leo: claimed for the dedicated-gpu capacity bump PR, also added the route tag. Do we need a JIRA/issue link in the one-liner?

alex: not required in the one-liner itself. Put links in the PR body. The changelog entry should be compact so release notes stay scannable.

priya: will we run any linting on entries? I can see some previous entries were quite long and broke the layout.

alex: yes — lint runs 30m pre-cutoff. It enforces: max 120 chars, must start with [component], no markdown headings. If flagged, you'll get a bot comment on the PR.

jack: thanks — putting a short one now.

release-bot: heads-up: format-check scheduled at 2272503240. If your PR is missing a changelog entry or fails lint, the bot will post a comment. Use `/release note` in PR thread to surface to the release leads.

alex: final note: if you claim but then unclaim, update this thread. I'll keep a running list and help merge tiny wording tweaks. :thumbsup:

maria: updated wording per alex suggestion. done.

sara: confirmed in PR that bot didn't flag anything.

release-bot: format-check completed at 2272501567 — all claimed PRs passed lint except #4099 (flagged: missing component tag). @jack @team please fix before cutoff.
